finish_summary:
Discrepancies:
1) bulk_discount_percent: returns 5% for quantity>=50 but spec says 10%. Bug in implementation.
2) parse_coupon does not ignore surrounding whitespace or case-insensitive properly; it raises ValueError for codes with leading/trailing spaces.
3) remove_item logic: item remains when quantity becomes zero (should be removed). Also does not raise KeyError if quantity is greater than existing? Actually deletes only if negative.
4) total method uses shipping_fee(self.subtotal(), member) instead of amount after coupon; shipping fee computed on wrong base.
5) shipping_fee: implementation checks subtotal >=1000, correct. (no discrepancy)
6) apply_discount and others are fine.
